description:
The newly designed Dolan Pre Cursa features an updated tapered head tube that enhances the frame's overall stiffness, providing better handling and control. The addition of double-sided dropouts increases the bike's strength and offers better protection.It also comes in two new coluorways: Chameleon Purple and Blue with a matte finish, and Starlight Black with a glossy finish. It has a rock-solid construction, featuring a triple-butted aluminium frame, ensures the lightweight strength needed for track cycling. This bike has been rigorously tested on the track by top professionals in the industry, ensuring it meets the high standards required for competitive racing.
FRAME DETAILS

Frame: Dolan Pre Cursa 7005 Aluminium Triple Butted.
Fork: Alpina Full carbon track specific fork 11/8"-11/2", carbon fibre blades, Carbon steering column.
Colour: Chameleon Purple/Blue Matt | Starlight Black, white decals, Gloss finish.

components.description: Alpina Full Carbon 11/8"-11/2" Track Fork - Matt (With Brake Hole)
